source.note: Captures Gemini multimodal generationConfig.responseModalities handling. The Go integration test feeds Path='/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview:generateContent' with body {contents:[{role:'user',parts:[{text:'Draw a green apple'}]}], generationConfig:{maxOutputTokens:1024, temperature:1, topP:1, responseModalities:['TEXT','IMAGE']}}. It asserts Model='gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview', MaxTokens=1024, and crucially chatReq.Modalities==['text','image'] (lowercased) and that the regenerated Gemini outbound body's GenerationConfig.ResponseModalities==['TEXT','IMAGE'] (UPPERCASE preserved). selected_channel and upstream_http/client_http are null (the test only verifies request + outbound-body stages for this case).

inbound_http._comment: Verbatim inline JSON body from TestGeminiTransformers_Integration case 'message with modalities'. Path uses model 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview'.

unified_request._comment: Asserted by the Go test: Model='gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' (from path), MaxTokens=1024 (from generationConfig.maxOutputTokens), one user message 'Draw a green apple', Modalities==['text','image'] (the Go transformer lowercases the Gemini responseModalities strings when populating llm.Request.Modalities).

outbound_http._comment: Asserted by the Go test step 2: method=POST, url='https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview:generateContent', Content-Type='application/json'. Body unmarshals to GenerateContentRequest whose GenerationConfig.ResponseModalities==['TEXT','IMAGE'] (UPPERCASE is restored on the outbound path).
